messages:
Nora Patel: Heads-up 1: were prepping a one-page technical preflight for three renewal-risk accounts. Goal: quick customer-fill checklist + 3 reproducible checks (cache, batch, stream) so AMs can triage before the call. Thoughts?

Diego Morales: Keep it form-like. Short fields + short "what to run" section. Include thresholds: cache_hit < 35% = candidate for prefix caching; p95 > 600ms = escalate; error_rate > 1% = open SRE ticket.

Priya Shah: For streaming advice: recommend enabling streaming when median response > 300ms or p95 > 500ms. For interactive UI flows, prefer batch_size 1-4 and low concurrency. Add a checkbox for "using prefix caching" vs "response caching".

Nora Patel: Also add renewal signals mapping to AM actions (e.g., low usage -> product review; rising latency -> ops call; billing disputes -> finance review). Keep each mapping one line.

cs_bot: Tip: run `/autofill-metrics <acct>` to populate cache_hit and latency fields automatically.

Owen Li: Quick validation snippets for engs:
1) streaming smoke test:
```
curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Prefer: streaming=1" \ 
  -d '{"input":"hello","stream":true}' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
```
2) p95 check (bash):
```
for i in {1..20}; do time curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate; done
```

Priya Shah: Tiny customer-fill template (pasteable into email):
---
ACCOUNT PREFLIGHT (please complete)
- Account name:
- Eng contact (name/email):
- Endpoint(s):
- Cache approach (prefix/response/shared KV):
- Cache TTLs (s):
- Cache hit % (7d):
- batch_size (min/max):
- streaming enabled? (y/n):
- p95 latency (24h):
- error rate (24h):
- recent config changes (14d):
- priority flows (1-3):
---

Diego Morales: Recommended quick fixes checklist:
- Increase cache_ttl to 1800-3600s for stable prompts
- Use prefix caching for repetitive prompts
- Reduce batch_size to 1-4 for interactive paths
- Enable streaming for long-running generation (>400ms)
- For bursts, prefer warm-pools/autoscale burst over huge batches

Nora Patel: Can someone produce a one-pager PDF + plain-text email snippet by EOD? Tag me and I'll route to AMs.

Owen Li: I'll assemble the PDF and add node/python smoke tests to the repo. Will post draft in ~2h.

cs_bot: Created ticket CS-OPT-4312 to track artifact. Assigned to Owen Li.

Nora Patel: Thanks team. This will speed up our renewal triage and reduce back-and-forth with customer engs.
